text.arabic_uthmani: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

words.gloss_range: vocative lordship with first-person plural dependence; locally an angelic appeal carried over from the prior prayer
words.root_gloss_range: nurture, ownership, sustaining rule, and bringing dependents toward completion; local use selects relational lordship in direct address
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbanā}}) keeps the speakers inside the same angelic supplication from 40:7, so the ayah opens as continued dependence rather than a new speaker frame. The suffix makes lordship relationally definite: the appeal comes from those who belong to the addressed Lord's care and rule before any imperative is voiced. Its root field lets the request for abiding gardens be heard under sustaining governance, while the closing titles will disclose the might and wisdom by which that lordship admits and selects.

topics.headline: continued angelic address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins inside an already-running angelic prayer, with collective dependence fused into the address word itself.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies a vocative noun with a first-person plural suffix, and boundary evidence keeps the same supplicatory speech from 40:7 active.

topics.headline: lordship as care and governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the request as made to the One who sustains, governs, and completes dependents, not to a neutral power holder.
topics.reason: The root field supports nurture, ownership, and governance, while the local form is a direct address title rather than a separate claim about abiding.

topics.headline: lordship answered by final titles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed from relational appeal at the start to the power-and-wisdom warrant at the end.
topics.reason: The vocative stands before the imperative and the final attributes close the same petition, giving the ayah an opening-and-seal structure.

words.gloss_range: prefixed conjunction joining the admission request to the prior prayer-chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches the new imperative to the preceding intercession instead of letting the admission request stand alone. Its prefixed form makes the command arrive already joined to earlier protection language, so 40:8 continues the movement from guarding to admitting.

topics.headline: admission joined to prior petitions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that admission is another coordinated request in one angelic intercession, not a detached wish.
topics.reason: The particle is marked as a conjunction and the boundary evidence links this ayah to the preceding protection request.

topics.headline: connector fused to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the imperative as visually and phonologically attached to prior discourse from its first particle.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the prefixed conjunction from the following imperative while preserving its proclitic role.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperative of caused admission with a 3mp object suffix; locally a request that God grant entry
words.root_gloss_range: entering, inclusion, insertion, and access; local Form IV selects caused admission into the garden destination
words.prose: {{ar:أَدْخِلْهُمْ}} ({{tr:adkhilhum}}) makes salvation a caused admission: the promised group is the object carried by the suffix, and the addressed Lord is asked to bring them in. The omitted entry preposition tightens recipients and destination, so the movement feels like authorized passage into a protected interior rather than self-directed arrival. Because the imperative comes before the garden destination, controlled access is heard before reward imagery, with the same group carried toward that destination. Against 13:23 and 40:40, the word keeps this scene in petition mode: what other passages state as entry is here requested as divine action after the protection plea of 40:7.

topics.headline: Form IV divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believers are not portrayed as entering by themselves; the prayer asks God to cause their admission.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV imperative with a 3mp object suffix, and attachment evidence makes that suffix the direct object.

topics.headline: tightened access into protected space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the request as controlled inward access into a protected destination, while the local wording leaves the preposition implicit.
topics.reason: The lexical entry field supports access and entry, and the ellipsis evidence licenses the omitted entry frame without requiring an overt preposition.

topics.headline: entry requested after protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah turn protection from punishment in 40:7 into a positive request for admitted placement.
topics.reason: The row evidence contrasts this imperative with entry statements in 13:23 and 40:40 and connects it with the 40:7 protection handoff.

topics.headline: access before reward imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears gatekeeping action before the attractive garden phrase, with the same group carried into the destination.
topics.reason: The imperative precedes the destination object, and the object suffix preserves the prayed-for group through the boundary transition.

words.gloss_range: plural garden destination governed by admission and gathered by a following feminine singular relative
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, enclosed garden, and hiddenness; local noun selects fertile protected garden space
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتِ}} ({{tr:jannāti}}) names the destination as abundant garden space, yet the following relative pronoun gathers that plurality into one promised destination-complex. The root field keeps the reward from being only decorative pleasure: it is covered, enclosed refuge into which the Form IV admission grants access. The singular-garden variant sharpens the same number pressure without displacing the local plural.

topics.headline: abundance gathered as one destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many gardens are still treated as one promised destination-complex.
topics.reason: The noun is plural, while the relative pronoun agrees as feminine singular with the destination phrase.

topics.headline: garden as protected enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the gardens as fertile protected interiority, not just a pleasant reward scene.
topics.reason: The j-n-n field supports covering and enclosed garden space; hidden-being derivatives add texture but do not replace the local garden sense.

topics.headline: reward formula with number pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar reward formula whose plurality can be contrasted with a singular collective reading, while local syntax keeps the plural surface active.
topics.reason: Formula evidence links the phrase to garden-reward contexts, and the singular variant is useful as contrast rather than as the governing local surface.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct complement classifying the gardens as abiding or settled residence
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, settling, abiding, and fixed repository; local phrase selects settled reward abode
words.prose: {{ar:عَدْنٍ}} ({{tr:ʿadnin}}) classifies the gardens from inside the construct phrase: they are gardens of abiding, not gardens with a removable descriptive extra. The root's settling and repository imagery makes the promised reward feel embedded and stable, and the fixed garden-promise cluster links 40:8 with the promised abode of 9:72 while keeping the current use as angelic petition.

topics.headline: permanence defines the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abiding is built into the destination's class, not added as an outside adjective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as genitive in construct with the garden noun.

topics.headline: rooted residence and embedded value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward as rooted residence and stable depth rather than passing delight.
topics.reason: The root field supports settling and repository imagery, while the local phrase selects abiding residence rather than mining as the surface sense.

topics.headline: marked reward abode in promise formulae
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a marked reward-abode term where divine promise becomes a settled place.
topics.reason: Occurrence and collocation rows link the noun to a small fixed garden-reward cluster, with 9:72 serving as a concrete promise parallel.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular relative pronoun referring back to the whole garden-abode phrase
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) gathers the plural garden phrase as a feminine singular destination and routes the next clause back to that whole abode. The relative does not introduce a new object; it identifies the already named gardens as the ones God promised, making divine speech part of the destination's identity.

topics.headline: plural gardens gathered by singular relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many gardens are grammatically gathered as one promised destination-complex.
topics.reason: QAC marks a feminine singular relative pronoun, and attachment evidence links it to the garden-abode phrase.

topics.headline: promise clause defines the destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gardens identified by God's prior promise, not only by paradise imagery.
topics.reason: The relative clause is syntactically forced as modifying the destination phrase and carrying the promise predicate.

words.gloss_range: perfect promise verb with 2ms subject and 3mp object suffix inside the relative clause
words.root_gloss_range: future-binding by promise or threat; local garden object selects beneficent pledge and fulfillment warrant
words.prose: {{ar:وَعَدتَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:waʿadttahum}}) makes the petition rest on an existing pledge: the angels ask for realization of what God has already promised. The same object suffix binds the promised recipients to the admission request, while the garden-abode object narrows the root away from threat toward beneficent commitment. The appointment-language pressure makes the promise more than vague benevolence: it moves toward a determinate abiding place. Placed before the family expansion, the clause anchors the destination in divine speech before kin inclusion is widened.

topics.headline: fulfilled pledge requested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prayer is not inventing an entitlement; it asks God to realize a prior promise.
topics.reason: The perfect verb sits in the relative clause modifying the gardens and functions as the stated warrant for the request.

topics.headline: promiser and recipients fused in one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God as promiser and the same believers as promise-recipients without either party needing to be renamed.
topics.reason: The verb carries the 2ms subject marking and 3mp object suffix, and the same suffix links admission and promise.

topics.headline: future-binding narrowed to mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears future-binding force as mercy and pledge, while the local garden context blocks the threat branch.
topics.reason: The root range includes threat-related futures, but the garden destination and Form I promise context select beneficent pledge here.

topics.headline: destination identified before family expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine promise named before lineage is widened, so kinship does not become the warrant for admission.
topics.reason: The promise clause follows the garden phrase before the coordinated family inclusion, and cross-reference rows tie this promise to 9:72 and 40:55.

words.gloss_range: additive conjunction introducing the qualified family-inclusion phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the promised destination to added entrants. It widens the admission request to family relations without making them a later sequence or a separate privilege clause, because the next words immediately impose the soundness condition.

topics.headline: qualified kin added to admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy widening outward from the promised group while remaining inside the same admission request.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the family phrase as an additional admitted object group under the main imperative.

topics.headline: addition without independent sequencing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the family clause as bound addition, not a later stage after the first group enters.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction attaches the family phrase to the prior object frame without marking temporal sequence.

words.gloss_range: open personal relative or conditional-like pronoun qualified by the following soundness verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following soundness verb that narrows the open human class

words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the family addition as an indefinite human class, then immediately waits for {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) to narrow it. Whether coordinated with the prior object group or supplied under an implied admit command, the phrase remains a beneficiary of the same petition, so the clause is about actual persons from kin relations rather than lineage as an abstraction.

topics.headline: whoever is narrowed by soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a broad personal opening that becomes selective only through the following soundness predicate.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as conditional or relative, and attachment evidence makes it the subject of the following verb.

topics.headline: beneficiary under main request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the family phrase as compressed into the admission petition, even where the exact syntactic route can be parsed two ways.
topics.reason: The evidence licenses coordination with the object group or an implied admit verb; both keep the pronoun phrase inside the same admission request.

words.gloss_range: intransitive perfect describing attained soundness or fitness for each eligible person
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, repair, suitability, righteousness, and reconciliation; local use selects a person's fit state for admission

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the open personal pronoun qualified by the soundness verb

words.prose: {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}) is the hinge that widens family mercy without turning kinship into entitlement. As an intransitive perfect with {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), it describes an attained state of soundness in each eligible person, and its position before the ancestors-spouses-descendants list lets fitness govern every family axis in advance. The stative variant strengthens that quality reading without changing the local filter. The 13:23 family-entry parallel keeps this condition recognizable while 40:8 recasts it as angelic petition.

topics.headline: intransitive state of fitness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that admissibility is described as the person's attained sound state, not as a repair action performed in this clause.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb with the pronoun subject, and the local clause has no object.

topics.headline: soundness governs kinship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the kin list opened generously but governed morally and ontologically before any relation is named.
topics.reason: The root field supports soundness, suitability, and righteousness, and the word precedes the partitive kin list.

topics.headline: Form I state with stative variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears established quality as the relevant pressure, while causative repair forms remain outside the local surface.
topics.reason: The surface is Form I and the vocalic variant supports stative coloring; causative repair forms are contrastive, not locally active.

topics.headline: 13:23 family-entry condition repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the sound-family condition with 13:23 while seeing 40:8 recast it as angelic petition.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give 13:23 as a concrete family-entry parallel and identify the current word as the shared eligibility condition.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the kin source-set from which qualified persons are selected
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the following family categories into a source-set under selection. One preposition scopes over ancestors, spouses, and descendants, so the list is expansive in range but partitive under the same soundness criterion.

topics.headline: kin groups selected from relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that kinship supplies the range from which sound members are selected, not a bloc admitted automatically.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the family nouns as governed complements after the soundness condition.

topics.headline: one preposition governs all kin axes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ancestors, spouses, and descendants placed under one grammatical filter.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the later nouns coordinated under the same prepositional government.

words.gloss_range: plural genitive ancestors or fathers with 3mp possessive suffix under the partitive preposition
words.root_gloss_range: fatherhood, ancestry, source, and origin relation; local plural selects backward kin lines, not refusal or pride semantics

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the partitive preposition governing the kin source-set

words.prose: {{ar:ءَابَآئِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ābāʾihim}}) begins the named kin list by reaching backward to fathers and forebears. Its suffix ties those ancestors to the promised recipients, but its genitive dependence keeps them inside the {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) selection frame. The root dispute is useful only as a boundary: this is ancestry and origin-source language, not the refusal field, and it frames one end of family time opposite the descendants.

topics.headline: ancestors tied but filtered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ancestors are relationally attached to the believers but still grammatically filtered by the partitive frame.
topics.reason: QAC marks a plural noun in genitive after the preposition with a 3mp suffix.

topics.headline: fathers as forebears and origin-lines
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prayer reach backward into origin-lines without making origin an automatic privilege.
topics.reason: The plural can extend fatherhood into forebears; the local selection frame prevents that ancestry from becoming entitlement.

topics.headline: kinship root kept distinct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids importing refusal or pride into a kinship-list word whose local job is ancestry.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is preserved as a boundary on overreading; local grammar and meaning select fatherhood and ancestry.

topics.headline: first term in family-time arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list begin at origin-lines and move through spouses toward continuation.
topics.reason: Rows identify the 13:23 family formula and the local ordered list from ancestors through spouses to descendants.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating spouses with ancestors under the same governed kin phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the shared preposition governing the kin list

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings spouses into the governed kin series without starting a new clause. It makes the middle relation parallel to ancestors under the same {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and soundness scope, so pairhood is honored without bypassing the selection criterion.

topics.headline: spouses under same filter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spouse inclusion stays inside the same prepositional and soundness frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates spouses with the first kin noun under the same preposition.

topics.headline: middle connector blocks hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spouses placed beside ancestry as a parallel relation, not a secondary afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction adds the second kin item without a new verb or fresh preposition.

words.gloss_range: plural genitive spouses or paired counterparts with 3mp possessive suffix under the kin source-set
words.root_gloss_range: pairing, joining, matching, spousehood, and counterpart relation; local noun selects existing spouse-relations in the kin list
words.prose: {{ar:أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ}} ({{tr:azwājihim}}) adds horizontal counterpart relation between backward ancestry and forward posterity. The plural suffix distributes spouse-relations across the promised group, but the genitive coordination keeps them inside the same eligibility filter. The pairing field is active as existing relation and compatible counterpartship, not as a new act of pairing inside the scene. Its middle position also matches the 13:23 kin-reunion pattern, where spouses stand between ancestors and descendants.

topics.headline: spouses attached and filtered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spouses are included relationally but remain inside the same selected source set.
topics.reason: QAC marks a plural genitive noun with suffix, coordinated under the preposition.

topics.headline: horizontal paired relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees family reunion include horizontal counterpartship, while local grammar keeps it as an existing kin category rather than an action of pairing.
topics.reason: The z-w-j field supports pairing and spousehood; verbal pairing forms are contrastive rather than the local noun sense.

topics.headline: multiple households in the reunion pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears spouse inclusion as a group-wide kin relation and as the middle term of the 13:23 reunion pattern.
topics.reason: Rows link the term to the 13:23 kin triad and note its central position between ancestors and descendants.

words.gloss_range: final conjunction coordinating descendants as the third kin category under the same frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) completes the kin triad by adding descendants alongside ancestors and spouses. The final clitic keeps posterity in the same governed series and the repeated conjunctions accumulate the family arc until the forward line is named.

topics.headline: descendants parallel under same frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices descendants added as a parallel kin category, not an afterthought outside the soundness filter.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates descendants with the prior kin categories under the same prepositional frame.

topics.headline: repeated conjunction closes family arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated conjunctions build a cumulative family list from source to continuation.
topics.reason: The row identifies repeated coordination across the three kin nouns as list closure.

words.gloss_range: plural genitive descendants with 3mp possessive suffix, final coordinated member of the kin source-set
words.root_gloss_range: progeny, scattering, small particles, multiplication, and brought-forth life; local noun selects descendants and posterity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the partitive preposition keeping posterity under the selection frame

words.prose: {{ar:ذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhurriyyātihim}}) carries the family request forward into posterity while staying bound to the same recipients by suffix and the same {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) filter by case. Its root field makes descendants feel like multiplied continuation, but the condition prevents continuation from becoming entitlement. As the most variant-pressured kin noun in the ayah, its number, vowel, hamza, and repeated-sound pressures intensify whether posterity is heard as many lines or a collective body, while 13:23 confirms the same kin-triad pattern.

topics.headline: descendants attached but conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices posterity included through relation but held under the same soundness selection.
topics.reason: QAC marks a plural genitive noun with suffix as the final coordinated kin category under the preposition.

topics.headline: seedlike forward spread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels descendants as proliferating forward life, while local grammar keeps that proliferation selected by soundness.
topics.reason: The root field supports progeny, scattering, and multiplication; local use remains the descendant noun.

topics.headline: number and sound density in posterity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears posterity as the most textually pressured kin noun, with variants and sound texture pressing between collective and proliferating lineage.
topics.reason: Variant rows show number, vowel, and hamza pressure, while sound rows support audible density without overriding the local plural descendant surface.

topics.headline: 13:23 descendant term reused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the forward edge of this prayer with the same ancestor-spouse-descendant reunion pattern in 13:23.
topics.reason: Rows explicitly cite 13:23 as the same kin-triad pattern with the descendant term.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle with 2ms suffix opening the grounding nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:innaka}}) shifts the ayah from petition into grounded assertion. The suffix is the subject of the emphatic clause, so the closing titles become a confirmed warrant for admission and selection, addressed personally to the same Lord invoked at the start. The prayer's specific family request is thus gathered under a broader claim of divine might and wisdom.

topics.headline: closing names as confirmed basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final names are a grammatical warrant for the request, not a loose devotional afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC marks the emphatic particle with subject suffix, and attachment evidence links the following predicates to this clause.

topics.headline: assertion and address in one word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing rationale remain directly addressed to God rather than becoming impersonal theology.
topics.reason: The particle and 2ms suffix are fused in one word, and the next pronoun reinforces the same addressee.

topics.headline: specific request universalized by attribute tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah stop adding beneficiaries and instead ground the whole prayer in enduring divine attributes.
topics.reason: The inna clause follows the imperative, relative, and kin-filter material as a closing declarative clause.

words.gloss_range: independent 2ms pronoun reinforcing or separating the subject before the predicate titles

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding emphatic address form whose subject is repeated

words.prose: {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) repeats the addressee already present in {{ar:إِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:innaka}}), focusing the predicate titles on God alone. As an independent pronoun, it briefly delays the two names so they land as the focused answer to the tension between promised admission and selective kin inclusion.

topics.headline: subject doubled before the names
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee is focused exclusively before the power-and-wisdom titles arrive.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent pronoun, and attachment evidence treats it as reinforcing the subject contained in the prior word.

topics.headline: pronoun bridge to closing titles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the titles arrive with extra weight because the pronoun holds them back for a beat.
topics.reason: The pronoun intervenes between the emphatic subject and the two predicate titles.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative divine predicate title of might, invincibility, preciousness, and difficult access
words.root_gloss_range: strength, reinforcement, invincibility, preciousness, and difficult access; local title grounds the power to admit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the admission imperative whose access problem the title answers
the paired wisdom title completing the closing formula

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzu}}) lands as a definite predicate title, not a temporary ability activated only for this request. Its might-and-difficult-access field answers the access problem raised by {{ar:أَدْخِلْهُمْ}} ({{tr:adkhilhum}}): the One hard of access grants access to the hidden gardens. The title also joins a recurrent petition closure with {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmu}}), including 2:129, and reactivates the surah-local might thread from 40:2 and 40:42.

topics.headline: settled predicate of might
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that might is asserted as a standing divine title, not a one-off capacity for this scene.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the definite nominative title as a predicate, and form evidence supports stable attribute force.

topics.headline: inaccessible One grants access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine might answer the gatekeeping force of admission: access is granted by the One beyond ordinary access.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports might and difficult access; local context ties that force to the Form IV admission request.

topics.headline: petition closure and surah-local might
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closing title pair with 2:129 and with the surah's own might vocabulary.
topics.reason: Rows cite 2:129 for the petition closure pair and 40:2 plus 40:42 for the surah-local recurrence.

words.gloss_range: second definite nominative divine predicate title of wise governing judgment
words.root_gloss_range: wisdom, judgment, governance, restraint, making firm, and precise ordering; local title grounds selection and ordered mercy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the soundness condition that wisdom orders within the kin request
the paired might title in the closing formula
the opening vocative frame answered by the final attributes

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmu}}) completes the closing pair as the title that orders the widened kin request. Its wisdom is not sentimental looseness: the root field of judgment, restraint, firmness, and ordering answers why family inclusion passes through {{ar:صَلَحَ}} ({{tr:ṣalaḥa}}). Together with {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzu}}), it repeats the exact petition seal of 2:129 and closes the ayah's architecture from {{ar:رَبَّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbanā}}) to the attributes that can fulfill promise and judge fitness.

topics.headline: second stable predicate completes the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices wisdom as a standing paired divine title, not an incidental description after might.
topics.reason: The word is the second definite predicate coordinated with the prior title and shares the stable attribute pattern.

topics.headline: wisdom as governing judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wisdom answer the family-selection problem by ordering mercy through fitness.
topics.reason: The ḥ-k-m field supports judgment, restraint, and precise ordering; local context ties it to the soundness filter and kin inclusion.

topics.headline: 2:129 seal and ayah architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the exact 2:129 closing formula and sees the whole ayah sealed by power to admit and wisdom to select.
topics.reason: Rows cite 2:129 for the exact formula and identify the final nominal clause as resolving the whole petition.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative asks the Lord to cause a boundary crossing into a cultivated, enclosing interior. The relative clause makes that crossing the execution of a prior commitment rather than access won at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies the agent who can authorize and effect the requested transfer.
Literal ingress supplies the boundary crossing that the causative imperative asks God to perform.
The tree-screened garden supplies both the literal destination and its character as an enclosing cultivated interior.
A spoken commitment that opens expectation makes admission the fulfillment of an obligation God has assumed.

changed_reading.before: A request that the believers be placed in the paradise previously promised to them.
changed_reading.after: A request for God to enact a promised transfer across a boundary into a sheltered, cultivated interior whose accessibility rests on His own commitment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause extends admission in three relational directions, upward to fathers, laterally to spouses, and downward to descendants, but gates every direction with صلاح. The result is not automatic blood solidarity; it is the selective repair and reassembly of a dispersed kin network.

activation_trace.role: Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies the Lord's functional role in reconstituting the household.
صلاح as the opposite of فساد makes moral soundness, rather than kinship alone, the admission gate.
Reconciliation after estrangement supplies the social mechanism by which separated relations can be gathered without erasing the condition.
Fatherhood and nurture mark the upward generational relation included in the repaired group.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the lateral bond restored to co-presence.
Small particles spreading outward image the descendants as a dispersed downward extension gathered back into relation.

changed_reading.before: The principal beneficiaries may have righteous relatives added to their reward.
changed_reading.after: Admission selectively reconstitutes a whole relational field across generations and spouses, with صلاح repairing and delimiting the household at once.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing names the capacity to overcome every barrier and, immediately beside it, the restraint, judgment, and exact construction that direct that capacity. It therefore functions as both guarantee and control on the requested admission.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing force supplies the capacity to overcome death, separation, and every barrier to admission.
Restraint that prevents فساد makes power protective and discriminating rather than indiscriminate.
Exact, perfected construction supplies the ordering by which persons and relations are placed in their fitting destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes with a conventional affirmation that God is powerful and wise.
changed_reading.after: The names assert that admission is executable by prevailing power while wisdom constrains, selects, and perfectly orders that execution.

baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's split mapping lets the promise cue carry not only a speech commitment but also preparation of an عدة and a fixed, recurring appointment. On that branch, the destination is heard as provisioned and scheduled before the petitioners arrive.

activation_trace.role: A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the ordinary appointment structure.
Preparation of equipment or stored provision turns the promised destination into something made ready in advance.
A counted, recurring time adds temporal appointment to the destination's prior preparation.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are guaranteed by an earlier divine statement.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are also imaginatively carried as a prepared appointment, ready and temporally fixed before their occupants cross into them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, might is paired with knowledge and forgiveness, while حكم and قضاء repeatedly separate persons in truth. This turns the focus closure into an operational claim: the power that can reunite a household is exercised through just, effective classification.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing power anchors the focus claim that no obstacle can frustrate admission.
Judgment between people anchors the discriminating side of the focus closure.
The opening pairing of might with knowledge frames power as informed rather than bare force.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies the restorative use of divine capacity requested in the prayer.
The explicit assignment of judgment to God makes the focus name a governing function.
A cutting, decisive judgment supplies the act that turns moral distinction into destination.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the norm governing the decisive act.
Judgment already rendered between servants shows حكمة producing differentiated outcomes.
Perfect execution of a decided matter supplies the efficacy joining wisdom to might.

structural_cues: 40:2 pairs العزيز with العليم; 40:3 immediately spans forgiveness and severe penalty.
40:12, 40:20, 40:48, and 40:68 repeatedly move from divine judgment to an effective, differentiated result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated pairings of power, knowledge, forgiveness, truth, and effective judgment; I infer that the focus names guarantee a just execution of the petition. A live alternative is that العزيز الحكيم remains a general praise formula whose local mechanics should not be pressed.

changed_reading.before: The final names generally reassure the petitioner that God can grant the request.
changed_reading.after: The final names claim that God can execute the promised family admission and that His execution is truth-governed, discriminating, and effective rather than indiscriminate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent prayer surrounds garden admission with covering of sin and two requests for protection. Admission is therefore the constructive middle of a salvation sequence: damage is covered, destructive exposure is blocked, a sheltered destination with repaired relations is positively built, and residual evils are kept outside.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the positive transition at the center of the surrounding petitions.
A protecting shield activates the gardens as positive enclosure, not scenery alone.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer supplies the sequence's first restorative operation.
Deflecting harm supplies the negative boundary immediately before the requested garden ingress.
Merciful tenderness supplies the encompassing motive within which the sequence operates.
Repeated protection resumes the boundary operation after admission and kin reunion.
Whatever causes hurt supplies the material that must remain outside the protected interior.
Rescue joined to attaining good names the whole multi-stage movement as success.

structural_cues: 40:7 ends with protection from the punishment of hell, 40:8 asks admission and kin reunion, and 40:9 resumes protection from evils.
The object pronouns continue across the three ayat, so the focus request belongs to one sustained intercession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continuous prayer and branches of covering, harm-deflection, shielding, and rescue; I infer that admission is its constructive middle rather than one parallel benefit. The live alternative is a simple list of independent requests without a staged causal order.

changed_reading.before: Admission to the gardens is a standalone positive reward.
changed_reading.after: Admission is the positive enclosure at the center of a complete rescue process, converting forgiveness and protection into a sheltered life with repaired relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later uses of دخول repeatedly assign people to hell, while its occupants ask whether any path of خروج remains and the final command adds gates, abiding, and a settled lodging. Against that network, the focus imperative is the opposite terminal routing, not a temporary visit.

activation_trace.role: The focus ingress anchors the positive side of the surah's two-way destination routing.
The screened garden supplies the positive interior opposed to the fire's interior.
A sought passage to the outside supplies the failed reverse movement that makes destination entry terminal.
The command to cause Pharaoh's house to enter punishment supplies the punitive mirror of the focus imperative.
The arrogant entering hell confirms that دخول functions as adjudicated placement.
The final entry command supplies a second direct counter-command to the garden petition.
A door as the defined ingress point makes the boundary and its crossing explicit.
Persistence not quickly touched by ending supplies the irreversible duration of the assigned interior.
A lodging or settled abode makes entry a placement into a lasting home.

structural_cues: 40:11 asks whether there is any path out; 40:46, 40:60, and 40:76 answer with repeated entry into the contrary destination.
40:76 joins entry to gates, abiding, and a lodging, turning motion across a threshold into final placement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed entry scenes, a failed request for exit, and markers of permanence; I infer a binary terminal-routing mechanism. The live alternative is that the repeated دخول is rhetorical contrast without implying equal structural permanence for every detail of the two destinations.

changed_reading.before: The prayer asks for access to paradise.
changed_reading.after: The prayer asks for the beneficiaries' final routing into the good interior, opposite an irrevocable ingress whose occupants cannot find a path back out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing man belongs to آل فرعون yet is individually protected, while evil encloses that آل and the same house is ordered into punishment. This sequence activates من صلح as a boundary-redrawing operator: inherited or political household membership can be severed, and a righteous household can be reassembled across former affiliations.

activation_trace.role: Moral soundness anchors the focus criterion that redraws kin inclusion.
Ancestral relation anchors the vertical household whose membership is being qualified.
Paired relation anchors the lateral household whose membership is being qualified.
Dispersed descendants anchor the downward household whose membership is being qualified.
A man's آل as those who return to him and to whom he returns supplies a corporate affiliation that can conflict with personal faith.
Concealment of faith marks the believing member as internally distinct from his surrounding house.
Protection that deflects harm supplies the individual's separate routing from the corporate group.
Evil descending and enclosing its target supplies the contrary corporate routing.
The repeated آل identifies the affiliated group on which the contrary outcome closes.
Caused ingress converts corporate affiliation into a destination assignment.
Pharaoh's آل is the corporate object of entry, sharpening the contrast with the selectively righteous family in the focus.

structural_cues: 40:28 locates a believing man inside Pharaoh's آل; 40:45 protects him while evil encloses that آل; 40:46 assigns the آل to punishment.
The focus does not say all kin but inserts من صلح before fathers, spouses, and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed believer within Pharaoh's house followed by singular protection and corporate punishment; I infer that this sequence models moral redrawing of household boundaries. A live alternative is that آل فرعون denotes a regime or court rather than the domestic kin types listed in the focus, so the analogy is structural rather than identical.

changed_reading.before: Righteous members of an existing biological family are allowed to accompany one another.
changed_reading.after: صلاح redraws household destiny: a person can be released from a corrupt corporate house, and morally sound relations can be reassembled into a new destination-spanning household.

context_deltas.mechanism: The afterlife is called the house of settlement, while created habitation elsewhere combines settled ground, overhead construction, rest, and provision. These cues activate the gardens as a fully made habitat into which repaired relations are re-housed, not merely a landscape displayed as reward.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion anchor the habitat-maker who brings both persons and their setting to fitness.
The tree-screened garden anchors the cultivated habitat receiving the reassembled household.
A resident identified with a dwelling supplies the afterlife's character as inhabited home.
Fixity and settlement supply permanence to that inhabited home.
Dwelling and settling in a place supply repose as a designed function of habitation.
The earth made stable supplies the ground layer of a deliberately habitable environment.
Construction by joining parts supplies the overhead architectural layer of that environment.
Sustaining food supplies ongoing maintenance within the built habitat.

structural_cues: 40:39 contrasts temporary worldly enjoyment with the afterlife as دار القرار.
40:61 and 40:64 assemble rest, stable ground, a built sky, good form, and provision under the same divine lordship named in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stable afterlife home and a local template of designed habitation; I infer that the promised gardens re-house a repaired kin ecology in an enduring provisioned setting. The live alternative is that the creation template illustrates present beneficence and should not be projected architecturally onto the gardens.

changed_reading.before: The family is reunited inside a beautiful reward landscape.
changed_reading.after: The Lord re-houses a repaired family network within an enduring, cultivated, restful, and provisioned habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: 40:40 expands the focus's صالح into a person who intentionally does صالح while believing, whether male or female, and then uses the same entry and garden roots. Kin reunion is therefore an aggregation of qualified persons rather than passive transfer by association, while their shared life exceeds ordinary accounting.

activation_trace.role: Moral soundness anchors the condition placed over the focus's family list.
Intentional action turns صالح from inherited family status into enacted qualification.
The repeated صلاح directly resolves the focus condition through morally sound action.
The same ingress root makes these qualified actors the persons crossing the garden boundary.
The same garden branch identifies the destination with the focus's promised gardens.
An allotted gift supplies positive life after entry rather than entry as bare acquittal.
Counting and reckoning supply the measure explicitly surpassed by provision within the garden.

structural_cues: 40:40 repeats صالح, دخول, and جنة from the focus in one sentence.
The verse specifies male or female and belief before entry, then provision without حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-verbatim root repetition and explicit individual predicates; I infer that each reunited relative is a qualified entrant rather than a merely carried dependent. A live alternative is that the focus may still allow an additional family uplift beyond the minimum rule stated in 40:40.

changed_reading.before: Righteous relatives may enter through their association with the principal beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: Each relative is heard as a believing doer of صالح who enters in his or her own qualified capacity, and the focus asks that those entrants be reunited beyond a merely calculated payout.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact refrain that God's promise is true is twice joined to patience, and the latter occurrence allows only partial visibility before death and return. Combined with the packet's preparation and appointment branch, the focus promise becomes objectively ready and binding before its realization is visible to its recipients.

activation_trace.role: The divine commitment anchors the focus destination in a promise rather than present sight.
Preparation of provision supplies the exploratory claim that readiness can precede manifestation.
Holding oneself against impatience supplies the recipient's posture during deferred realization.
A promise fixed to an appointment supplies a future realization not invalidated by delay.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies objective validity before the event is seen.
The repeated restraint confirms that temporal delay is part of the promise's reception.
Counted and recurring time supplies an exploratory temporal structure for a promise only partly shown before return.
The repeated assertion of truth keeps fulfillment independent of immediate visibility.
Return to the originating authority supplies the far boundary across which deferred fulfillment remains binding.

structural_cues: 40:55 and 40:77 repeat اصبر إن وعد الله حق.
40:77 contrasts seeing only some of what is promised with dying before it and then returning to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated patience-promise-truth formula, partial visibility, death, return, and a split branch of preparation; I infer that readiness and validity precede manifestation. The live alternative is that the non-dominant preparation branch is associative and the context only confirms an ordinary future promise.

changed_reading.before: The promised gardens are a future benefit guaranteed by speech.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are a prepared, fixed destination whose truth already holds through delay, partial visibility, death, and eventual return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move is surprising because رحمة in 40:7 and 40:9 ordinarily names mercy, not genealogy. It remains anchored because the packet's kinship branch immediately surrounds a focus ayah that enumerates fathers, spouses, and descendants. Downstream prose should present this as a branch resonance that gives mercy a relational shape, not as a lexical replacement of mercy with womb or kinship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and nurture supply one vertical strand through which surrounding mercy becomes relationally concrete.
Joined counterparts supply the lateral strand of the kin network.
Dispersed small descendants supply the downward strand gathered by mercy.
The رحم and kinship branch lets encompassing mercy take concrete form as restored relation.
The repeated mercy root closes the family petition with the same kin-bearing resonance.

changed_reading.before: Family reunion is one extra benefit bestowed by divine mercy.
changed_reading.after: The repaired, multi-generational relation can itself be carried as a concrete shape taken by the encompassing mercy invoked around the focus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The model is surprising because it connects a concealed confession under Pharaoh to the semantic concealment and shield branches of جنة. It remains anchored in the focus's garden root and in the explicit concealment-then-protection sequence of 40:28 and 40:45. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial-affective transition, not claim that garden literally means secret faith in this ayah.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from perception supplies the garden's latent enclosure image.
A protective shield turns enclosure into durable safety rather than mere invisibility.
The believer's active hiding of faith supplies a precarious human-made concealment.
Divine deflection of harm converts precarious concealment into effective protection.

changed_reading.before: Garden entry moves believers into a visible place of reward.
changed_reading.after: Garden entry can also image transfer from fragile self-concealment amid a hostile house into a divinely made enclosure that protects without requiring fear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع و م mapping for وعد, with branches of swimming and the year. It remains packet-resolvable and is sharpened by the patience, death, and return frame around the repeated promise. Downstream prose must label it as an exploratory image of temporal carriage, never as the lexical meaning or preferred derivation of وعدتهم.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or moving through a medium supplies the exploratory image of a promise carrying its recipients toward arrival.
The yearly cycle supplies the temporal medium through which fulfillment may remain unseen yet active.
The promise joined to patience activates duration rather than immediate arrival.
A promise spanning partial sight, death, and return activates passage across an unseen medium.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a statement about a destination that will later be reached.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise itself becomes a mode of carriage across deferred time, holding the promised destination continuous through death until arrival.

strongest_changes: 40:7-9 turns garden admission into the constructive middle of a sequence of forgiveness, protection, repaired relation, and final rescue.
40:28 and 40:45-46 make من صلح a household-redrawing criterion: an individual can be released from a corrupt corporate house while righteous relations are reassembled.
40:39-40 and 40:64 turn the gardens into a stable, provisioned habitat and clarify each reunited relative as a believing doer of صالح.
40:11, 40:46, 40:60, and 40:76 make دخول a terminal destination assignment by opposing garden ingress to failed egress and abiding entry into hell.
40:55 and 40:77 strengthen the promise as true and prepared before it becomes visible.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition made the focus's ingress, garden, صلاح, family list, promise, and closing names operate as one mechanism of just routing and relational re-housing. The split وعد inventory also preserved exploratory preparation and time-crossing images that a dominant-root reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: 40:40 strongly supports individual qualification, but the focus may still imply an additional family uplift beyond that minimum rule.
The shelter, kinship-mercy, and concealed-faith links are branch resonances rather than secure lexical specifications.
The preparation and especially the ع و م time-crossing readings depend on non-dominant packet mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Entry gathers repaired kin into a concealed interior.** `د خ ل/B001` supplies going inside, and `ج ن ن/B001` supplies covering and concealment. The coordinated relatives extend the object beyond isolated individuals. I infer that promised entry reconstitutes a protected social interior; the gardens read as a gathered domain of concealment and safety, not merely a location.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The opposed entry into permanent fire-residence in 40:76 clarifies that entry organizes belonging; the contrast is gathered kinship versus gathered pride.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Entry repairs a household without making kinship automatic.** Lexically, `ص ل ح:B003` is "suitability or fitness for something," `ز و ج:B003` is pairing or joining, and `د خ ل:B001` is entering. Structurally, the prayer moves from individual followers in 40:7 to fathers, spouses, and descendants here, then back to protection from each person's evils in 40:9. Fitness acts as the hinge permitting separated relations to be rejoined at entry. The packet supplies the kin list and the condition `من صلح`; I infer that restored household coherence is one purpose of admitting them together. The promised gardens read as repaired relational settlement, but one filtered by fitness rather than inherited mechanically.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:76 supplies a dark household-counterpart: the proud also enter a permanent lodging, making the repaired garden household depend even more sharply on `من صلح`.

baseline.text: Rabbimiz! Onları ve atalarından, eşlerinden ve soylarından iyi olanları, kendilerine söz verdiğin kalıcı cennetlere koy. Şüphesiz sen güçlüsün, bilgesin.

findings.text: Cennete giriş, dağılmış yakınları korunaklı bir iç alanda yeniden bir araya getiren toplumsal bir yerleşme olarak belirir.
Ailenin yeniden birleşmesi soy bağının otomatik sonucu değildir; iyilik ve uygunluk, ilişkilerin onarılarak birlikte yerleşmesinin koşuludur.

pericope.label: Revelation, forgiveness, and the coming judgment

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici, düzenleyici ve Tanrı anlamlarını ortak bir üstün yetke ilişkisi çevresinde toplar; mutlak kullanımın sınırını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sahiplik ile düzenleyici yetkenin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kavramsal bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın hiçbir bağlı unsur olmadan mutlak kullanıldığı inanç bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'yı göstermesi sınırını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çocuk ile biyolojik olmayan bakımı üstlenen eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile ilişkisini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Üvey aile rolü ile bakım üstlenme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eşin önceki birlikteliğinden olan oğul veya kız çocuğu için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuğun yeni eşle kurduğu biyolojik olmayan aile bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Annenin eşi veya babanın eşi çocuğun bakımını üstlendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni eşin çocuk üzerindeki aile ve bakım rolünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin kendisini ve ondan hareketle yapılan işleme uygulamalarını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaşmış öz ile yağ tortusu seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm veya başka meyvelerden koyulaştırılmış özün söz konusu olduğu yiyecek bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Meyveden elde edilen koyu ve yoğun madde niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri kap, yiyecek veya ilacın koyu öz kullanılarak hazırlandığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Maddeyle işleme ve sağlamlaştırma ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Meyve özü veya yağ tortusuyla deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilacı işleyip güçlendirme odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erimiş metal, irin, katran suyu ve ekmek döküntüsü gibi çok çeşitli maddeler komşu dalda bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli koyu özü ve onun işleme işlevini anlatır; komşu dal ise ortak bir işlem olmadan çok farklı eriyik ve tortu türlerini aynı ad altında toplar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerden ayrılmama, bağlı kalma ve süreklilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya hayvan topluluğunun belirli yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yere bağlanma ve oradan ayrılmama sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulutun veya rüzgârın kesilmeden devam ettiği zamansal bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir durumun kesintisiz sürmesi anlamını korur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: رب بالمكان وأرب إذا أقام به (jamhara); مرب الإبل حيث لزمته؛ أربت الإبل؛ أربت الناقة؛ أربت الجنوب والسحابة أي دامت؛ الأرباب الدنو (sihah); أرب فلان بالمكان إذا أقام به فلم يبرحه؛ مرب الإبل أي حيث لزمته (tahdhib); أربت السحابة: دامت؛ أرب فلان بمكان كذا (mufradat); الأصل الآخر لزوم الشيء والإقامة عليه؛ أربت السحابة؛ الإرباب الدنو (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine binmiş ya da başka bulutların altında asılı duran bulut kümesidir; beyaz veya siyah olabilir.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut olma, katmanlaşma ve asılı durma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut parçalarının birbirine binerek bir küme oluşturduğu görünüm için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutun katmanlı ve birleşik yapısını korur.

error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su yüklü olma, siyahlık ve göksel burçla ilişki komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun, tazelik ve gençliğin başlangıcı aynı düzeyde bağımsız çekirdekler değil; ilk durum genel yenilik sınırının özel gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlar her yalın biçime sınırsızca genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz başlangıcında, yeni ve taze olmasıdır. Yeni doğurmuş koyun ile gençliğin ilk dönemi bu yakın zamanlılık niteliğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik yakın zamanda başlamış olma, yenilik ve tazeliktir.
Yeni doğurmuş veya süt için evde tutulan koyun, doğum sonrası yenilik durumunu taşır.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, başlangıç ve tazelik çekirdeğinin insan yaşamına genişlemesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yeni doğurmuş koyunu, bir şeyin ilk ve taze dönemini ve gençliğin başlangıcını yakın zamanda başlamış olma ortaklığında toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir ok veya kura çubuğunu değil, bunları bir arada tutan kap ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ok ve kura çubuklarını toplayan kap ile toplu oklar anlamında kalır; tek tek ok adlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok ve çubukları bir arada tutan deri ya da bez kap; buna bağlı olarak kabın içindeki okların topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Deri veya bezden yapılan kap, kura oklarını ve çubuklarını bir arada tutar.
Kabın içindeki okların topluluğu, kapsayan nesneden kapsanana geçen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar deri parçası, bez veya okluğa benzer kap anlatımında birleşir ve kura oklarının topluluğunu bununla bağlantılı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kura veya kumar oklarının konduğu deri ya da bez kabı anlatan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kap olma, okları toplama ve kura bağlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın kendisinden çok içinde bir araya getirilmiş okların bütünü kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Okların tek tek değil toplu hâlde bulunması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kura oklarını bir arada tutan deri veya bez kap

error_profile.preserves: Okları içinde toplama ve taşıma işlevini korur.
error_profile.adds: Savaş ve av oklarına özgü genel taşıma kabı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kura ve kumar bağlamındaki özel kap ile sıradan ok kabını karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kura çubuklarını bir arada tutan kap ve onların toplu hâli odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uç ve tüy takılmamış tek ok gövdesi ya da tek kura çubuğu komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok biçimli çubuklarla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çubukları toplayan kap veya takım düzeyindedir; komşu dal ise tek bir çubuğun kendisini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kap ile içindeki tek çubuk arasındaki temel ayrımı gösteren aday seçildi, belirli sıra okları ve oyunun bütünü tekrara yol açmamak için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست الربابة العهد، ولا الرباب السحاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الربابة: قطعة من أدم تجمع فيها القداح (jamhara); الربابة شبيهة بالكنانة تجمع فيها سهام الميسر؛ جماعة السهام (sihah); الربابة: جماعة السهام؛ الجلدة التي تجمع فيها السهام (tahdhib); لما يجمع فيه القدح ربابة (mufradat); الخرقة التي يجعل فيها القداح ربابة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, tarafları birbirine bağlayan sözleşme, güvence ve bağlılık düzenini ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Vergi veya onda bir pay anlamı, alındığında bağlayıcı söz gibi işlemesiyle açıklanan ikincil bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam karşılıklı bağlılık doğuran söz ve güvencedir; vergi payı ancak bu bağlayıcılığa dayanan özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan sözleşme, güvence ve ona bağlı insanlar alanında kalır; aynı biçimdeki kap veya bulut anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları karşılıklı bağlılık, güvence veya dayanışma içinde birleştiren sözleşme ve verilmiş sözdür. Bu sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler ile söz gibi bağlayıcı sayılan vergi payı da ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Karşılıklı söz ve güvence, taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir ilişki kurar.
Sözleşmeye bağlı kişiler bu bağın tarafları olarak topluca adlandırılır.
Vergi veya onda bir pay, bağlayıcı söz gibi işlediği açıklamasıyla aynı alana genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sözleşme, verilmiş söz, güvence ve ona bağlı kişileri ortak bir bağlayıcılık altında toplar; vergi payını açıklamalı bir uzantı olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tarafları karşılıklı bağlılık ve koruma ilişkisine sokan sözleşme için genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Söz verme, bağlayıcılık, güvence ve tarafları birleştirme öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilmiş söz veya güvence düzeninin tarafları topluca kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin aynı bağlayıcı söz çevresinde birleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vergi veya onda bir payın sözleşmeye benzer bağlayıcılıkla adlandırıldığı özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi payı ile bağlayıcı söz arasındaki açıklanmış ilişkiyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: tarafları birleştiren bağlayıcı söz veya sözleşme
sözleşmeye bağlı taraflar
bağlayıcı söz; söz gibi bağlayıcı vergi payı

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arasında bağlayıcı söz kurulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güvence, bağlı kişiler ve vergi payına uzanan kullanım alanını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözleşmeye bağlı kişilerin toplu adı ve vergi payına yapılan uzantı odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yemin, güvenli geçiş, korunan hak alanı ve söz veren kişinin nitelenmesi komşu dalda daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da verilmiş söz, sözleşme, güvence ve bu güvenceye bağlı taraflar alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insanları bir araya getiren bağ ve onun taraflarını öne çıkarır; komşu dal sözün korunması, yemin ve güvenlik sonuçlarını daha geniş kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sözleşme ve güvence çekirdeğini en yakın paylaşan aday seçildi, sözün kurulması, bozulması veya yalnız vekâlet alanındaki adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt belirli bir bitki ya da birkaç bitki için kullanılan adı destekler, ancak bunun ağaç, genel bitki veya yumuşak ot oluşunda tanıklıklar aynı ayrıntıyı vermez. Yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma yalnız bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak bütün yeşil bitkileri değil, adı bu biçimde verilen bir veya birkaç belirli bitki türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bitki adıyla sınırlıdır; genel otluk, ağaçlık veya bütün yaz yeşil kalan bitkiler anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak ot, başka bir bitki veya küçük ağaç olarak betimlenen belirli bir bitki adıdır; bazı türlerinin yazın kurumadan yeşil kaldığı belirtilir.

facets.statement: Ad, genel bitki sınıfını değil belirli bir bitki ya da bitki grubunu gösterir.
Bitkinin ot, başka bir bitki veya ağaç sayılması tanıklıklara göre değişir.
Yumuşaklık ve yazın kurumadan yeşil kalma bazı tanımlarda ayırt edici özelliktir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bunun belirli bir bitki adı olduğunda birleşir; ot, ağaç ve yumuşak yazlık yeşil bitki betimleri arasında kapsam farkı bırakır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Türün tam bitkibilimsel karşılığı belirlenmeden, kanıttaki özel bitki adını açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Özel bitki adı oluşunu ve tür ayrıntısındaki belirsizliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yumuşak bir ot ve yazın kurumayan bitki olarak betimlenen özel tanıklık için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşaklık ve yaz boyunca yeşil kalma özelliklerini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belirli bir bitki, yumuşak ot veya küçük ağaç türü

error_profile.preserves: Bitki ve yumuşak yeşillik yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.adds: Bütün otsu bitkileri kapsayan geniş ve türsüz bir anlam ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ağaç olarak verilen tanıklığı ve özel tür adını görünmez kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir bitki adı olma ve bazı türlerinin yazın kurumadan kalması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağaç olmayan bütün taze yeşil otları kapsayan genel sınıf komşu dalın alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yumuşak ve yeşil otsu bitkileri gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel ve türü tam belirlenmemiş bir bitki adıdır; komşu dal ise ağaç olmayan taze yeşil bitkilerin genel sınıfını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; özel bitki adı ile genel yeşil ot sınıfı arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız başka özel bitki adları karşılaştırma değeri düşük olduğu için alınmadı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الربة: ضرب من الشجر أو النبت (jamhara); الربة بالكسر: ضرب من النبت، والجمع الربب (sihah); الربة: بقلة ناعمة؛ اسم لعدة من النبات لا تهيج في الصيف (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, temel olarak bol miktarda suyu ve bu adın suyun toplanmasıyla açıklanmasını destekler. Suyun tatlı olması mümkün bir nitelik olarak verilir, fakat bütün kullanımlar için zorunlu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Miktar çokluğu çekirdektir; tatlılık isteğe bağlı bir nitelik, havuz veya su yatağı ise bu dalın anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bol su anlamıyla sınırlıdır; suyu tutan yer, kuyu veya deniz gibi kap ve yer adları yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde toplanmış ya da çok miktarda bulunan sudur; bazı kullanımlarda tatlı su olduğu ayrıca belirtilir.

facets.statement: Belirleyici özellik suyun çok miktarda bulunması ve toplanmış olmasıdır.
Tatlılık bazı tanıklıklarda olası bir niteliktir, ancak çekirdeğin zorunlu koşulu değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar çok miktardaki su anlamında birleşir ve adlandırmayı suyun toplanmasına bağlar; tatlı su niteliğini zorunlu olmayan bir seçenek olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Suyun bulunduğu yerden çok miktarının ve birikmiş oluşunun anlatıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Su, miktar çokluğu ve toplanma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanıklığın suyun hem çok hem tatlı olduğunu açıkça belirttiği kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Miktar çokluğu ile belirtilmiş tatlılık niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: çok miktarda su; bazen bol tatlı su

error_profile.preserves: Suyun bir yerde toplanmış olması yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Belirli bir doğal su kütlesi ve yer biçimi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Miktar bildiren su adıyla suyun bulunduğu coğrafi yeri karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tatlı su olasılığı ve yalnız miktarı adlandırma odak dalda öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deniz, büyük nehir ve küçük ya da büyük göl gibi belirli su kütlesi türleri komşu dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da geniş veya çok miktarda suyu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suyun miktarını ve toplanmasını adlandırır; komşu dal ise büyük su kütlelerini ve onların coğrafi türlerini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bol su ile belirli su kütlesi arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız su yatağı, kuyu, kalıntı veya akış bildirenler yayımlanmadı.
